description: Journey v10 for the real-engine check (L2 c32): the merged layer-first (U13) flags as -off / -on pairs for the timing measure (scripts/egdesk-real-engine-timing.mjs compare <off> <on> --normalize "-off|-on"). prefetch-notes and prefetch-code (L7, EGDESK_TURN_MEMORY_PREFETCH=files: the named file is in the engine's turn context, no tool round) and tests (L3/L5, EGDESK_DECISION_FIRST=on: the decision model picks the command, EG-Desk runs it, a healthy run ends without an engine turn). The lanes' own scenarios and expectations are kept; added: expect.timing bounds from measured numbers (layers before the engine starts at most 3,000 ms; the -on conversations at most one engine round; c36: tests-on is action first, the default value of EGDESK_DECISION_FIRST: the command runs in the action layer, then the engine talks once with the result). Not in yet (flags not merged): approvals fast (L3), L1 open items, L7 memory-first. Needs --decisions.
